newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barges lightly quoted on call session.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barges lightly quoted on call session.

text.p: U.S. barge rates remained lightly quoted Tuesday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. No barges traded versus no trades on Monday. Bids and offers included:
- Two barges, this week, lower Ohio River, bid 105 percent of tariff, offered one barge at 115 percent.
- Two barges, next week, lower Ohio River, bid 105 percent, offered at 110 percent, unchanged from Monday.
- Two barges, next week, Illinois River, bid 125 percent, bid 135 percent.
